description.name: Protean Mode (Fire, Ice, Earth, Wind)
description.text: Grants [Attach Fire]/[Attach Ice]/[Attach Earth]/[Attach Wind] after using a Fire/Ice/Earth/Wind ability

description.name: Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gogo (VI)
description.text: Keeps track of the number of uses of Apex Punishing Meteor (0~2), removed after using Apex Punishing Meteor two times

description.name: Apex Punishing Meteor Damage Tracker
description.text: Increases Apex Punishing Meteor level by 1 after dealing 100001 total damage during the status, removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gogo (VI)]

description.name: Apex Punishing Meteor Level
description.text: Keeps track of Apex Punishing Meteor level (0~1), removed if the character hasn't [Arcane Dyad Empowered: Gogo (VI)]
